purpose: Diagnose why the already-registered REG.RU pc-prod GitHub Actions runner remains unavailable to GitHub scheduling after a bounded service restart, without mutating the runner, Docker, application, database, model runtime, credentials or customer data.
approvedBy: repository-owner direct continuation of Gekta SPEED #3896 and REG.RU release recovery on 2026-08-14
requiredBehavior: owner-only command is bound to issue 3365 and exact literal /tai diagnose-pc-prod-runner current-main
execute only from a GitHub-hosted runner through the existing protected REG.RU root SSH key and pinned host fingerprint
resolve exact current main before diagnostics
require exactly one pre-existing pc-prod actions.runner systemd service and read only its state and process metadata
verify the configured runner identity is pc-prod-* and the configured execution user is pcactions
test DNS and bounded HTTPS reachability to the fixed GitHub and GitHub Actions endpoints without authentication
classify only allowlisted runner diagnostic error categories and freshness counters; never publish raw runner logs or credential files
collect read-only filesystem and inode headroom counters
publish only bounded machine-readable diagnostic fields and the GitHub run URL
forbiddenCapabilities: systemctl start stop restart enable disable daemon-reload or service mutation
runner registration re-registration removal token consumption or config.sh invocation
reading or publishing .credentials .credentials_rsaparams OAuth tokens registration tokens or raw .runner content
publishing raw journalctl or runner _diag log lines
Docker container image volume network build-cache or registry mutation
application deployment rollback restart or configuration mutation
database model-host deal role money registration credential or customer-data mutation
unbounded remote shell input or user-controlled remote command arguments
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
